backend: CPU/MPI one rank; exact accepted A2 serial Born API behind MODE2 NP=1 dispatch
coordinate: fixed-density log velocity; H_log=A^T H_native A; native FP32 tangent API, FP64 native/log cotangent; mapping roundoff recorded
fluid: exact original Vs=0/mu=0; lnVs tangent frozen; no floor, epsilon or repair mask
inner_products: unweighted discrete Euclidean model/data dot products; no added DT/DH/area/source/receiver weights

low_frequency.conditional_source_gate: reproduce saved15Hz source from original spike/native libcseife filtering and psource conversion; then change only low-pass corner to5Hz with same rule

measurement.boundaries_cpml: primary full-grid metrics include all cells; separately full/interior x220..9800,z<=3280/acquisition x800..8780; bottomz>3280; no cropping or weights in H
measurement.centroid_moments: squared norm of full response; centroid and moments about centroid; report sigma_x/sigma_z and2*sigma widths; undefined on zero norm
measurement.classification: descriptive multiple labels, no new acceptance oracle: R90<=200 and peak within40m=>WELL LOCALIZED; peak within200 withR90>200=>BROAD BUT TARGET-CENTERED; guard squared norm exceeds target=>INTERFACE-DOMINATED; other norm exceeds same=>STRONG PARAMETER CROSS-TALK; R90>1000 or peak offset>400=>STRONG SIDELOBES/NONLOCAL; aperture interpretation from declared group comparisons; otherwise INDETERMINATE
measurement.cross_talk: full and target squared-norm and norm ratios of other/same log-coordinate channels; undefined when denominator zero
measurement.interface: water inferred per column from exact original Vs=0; first-solid separately;450<=z<650 guard; also guards ending550/750
measurement.main_lobe_primary: same fixed200m target disk; outside is fixed-window sidelobe (not an adaptive physical lobe)
measurement.main_lobe_secondary: 4-connected half-absolute-height component containing first row-major absolute local peak inside fixed400m disk; no resize or recenter; undefined for zero local peak
measurement.partitions: shallow650<=z<1000; deep1000<=z<=3280; injection-depth-neighborhood abs(z-z0)<=200 across full x; shallower/deeper off-target outside neighborhood
measurement.radius: physical Euclidean distance from injection sample centers; r50/r90 include complete tied radius shell; squared norm unweighted grid-coordinate sensitivity
measurement.target: Euclidean disk radius200m centered on injection, including boundary/water cells; no recentering

normalization: one discrete unit basis entry; log-space Euclidean norm1; a linear-algebra column, not a physical100percent anomaly

numerical_gates.case_gate: triangle-bound operand mismatch using historical constants, with explicit native/log input-rounding contribution; positivity additionally requires pair-relative<=7e-5 plus measured mapping roundoff; symmetry absolute bound7e-5*||Jzi||*||Jzj|| plus mapping roundoff; never epsilon-normalize

optional_extended_probes: not selected; point/interface/lateral matrix fixed before results
shot_order: physical IDs ascending 1..100; no shot weights/rejection
transpose: gLnVp=2*rho*Vp^2*gLambda; gLnVs=2*rho*Vs^2*(gMu-2*gLambda); no independent native output scaling
